summary: _ansible_debug (bool) enables verbose logging; messages from AnsibleModule.debug are only logged when it's True, accessible as AnsibleModule._debug.
questions: Why aren't my module's debug messages being logged?
How do I check if debug mode is on inside a module?

answer_card.title: _ansible_debug
answer_card.answer_md: Type `bool`. Enables verbose logging and logging of executed commands. Messages via `AnsibleModule.debug` are logged only when it's `True`. Access as `module._debug`; see `DEFAULT_DEBUG`.
